title: quick accent inserts `」` as `「` in the wechat desktop app
author: brauljo
summary: Quick Accent selects the closing corner bracket `」`, but WeChat Desktop receives the opening bracket `「`; the report includes deterministic app-specific behavior and a diagnostic attachment.

status.label: App-specific character reproduction ready
status.detail: A controlled comparison between WeChat and another text target can identify whether the emitted Unicode input or WeChat handling changes the character.

next_action.label: Reproduce Quick Accent in WeChat
next_action.reason: Capture the selected character, emitted code point, and receiving-app result before requesting more evidence.

judgment.rationale: The issue provides a specific expected and actual character, a named application, and a diagnostic archive. Maintainers can reproduce and instrument the input path without a generic information request.
evidence: Quick Accent selection is expected to insert U+300D `」`.
The report includes a PowerToys bug-report attachment.
No assignee, duplicate, or linked fix is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce in WeChat and a neutral text control, then compare the selected glyph, Unicode code point, and injected input sequence.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent emits or WeChat interprets a closing Japanese corner bracket as its opening counterpart.
known_information: The desired character is `」` and the received character is `「`.
The affected application is WeChat Desktop.
A PowerToys diagnostic ZIP is attached to the issue.
inferences: The failure may be application-specific if the same Quick Accent selection inserts correctly into a standard text control.
If multiple applications receive the wrong code point, the Quick Accent character mapping or injection path is more likely involved.
issue_context.analysis: The expected/actual pair and target application make the report directly testable. Cross-application reproduction plus input instrumentation will decide whether PowerToys emits the wrong value or WeChat transforms it.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue, attachment presence, labels, assignees, and timeline.
No existing maintainer response or linked remediation is present.

reproduce.version_requirements: Use the reported PowerToys version and retest on the current build if different.
prerequisites: Quick Accent configured with the character set containing `」`
steps: Insert `」` into Notepad through Quick Accent.
Record the glyph and Unicode code point.
Repeat the identical selection in WeChat Desktop.
If results differ, log the Unicode input sequence sent to each target.
reproduce.expected_result: Selecting `」` should insert U+300D consistently in both applications.
setup_requirements: Use the same keyboard layout and Quick Accent configuration for both targets.
